description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Phyrexian Altar to add one mana of any color.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Murderous Redcap returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter which cancel out.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
